verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas doesn't ship a built-in AI assistant UI inside the Editor itself, but it does provide an official MCP server that lets external AI assistants connect to an open Editor session to modify project data and verify results, plus 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving compatible AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows — enabling task delegation to AI, just via an external-agent bridge rather than an embedded assistant. missing for 10: an assistant chat UI embedded directly in the Editor, and independent hands-on evidence of using this delegation flow successfully.
